$comment: Project-scoped GAD CLI extensions for slm-learning. Each entry registers a command that the gad CLI should dispatch when run from this project root (or with --projectid slm-learning). The monorepo team is building the loader framework; this manifest is forward-compatible with their design and operates today via path-based dispatch. See handoff h-2026-05-08T01-00-00 for details.

extensions.name: slm eval classify-failures
extensions.description: Classify HumanEval failures into 9 buckets (think/truncation, code-truncated, wrong-signature, full-script, competitive-style, prose-pollution, indentation-bug, algorithm-fail, evaluator-bug). Reads persisted full-result JSONs from Modal volume.

args.name: --base
args.help: Path to base-model HumanEval results JSON

args.name: --lora
args.help: Path to LoRA HumanEval results JSON

extensions.name: slm eval aggregate-public-matrix
extensions.description: Compile HumanEval+MBPP eval logs into the comparator-matrix public-row report. Per slm-learning-103 (4 rows per candidate before promotion).

extensions.name: slm data prepare-ocr-variants
extensions.description: Build 5 OCR variants for controlled experiments (raw, no_think, function_normalized, mixed_instruction_50, high_quality_subset). Profiles + samples per variant. Does NOT train.

extensions.name: slm eval modal-fire
extensions.description: Fire a Modal eval job with project-standard args (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV, PYTHONIOENCODING, max_new_tokens, persist_run_id). Wraps the modal_app/eval_adapter.py entrypoint to remove operator-error landmines.
extensions.rationale: Encodes the bug-tax lessons from autonomous run 2026-05-07 (MSYS path translation, dataset_limit, L4 timeout) so future operators don't re-discover them.

see_also.future_framework: Monorepo team is building the dynamic CLI extension loader. When the framework lands, this manifest stays the same; the gad CLI gains the ability to dispatch `gad slm eval classify-failures` directly. Until then, operators run the scripts via path: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe <module> --args`.
see_also.decision: slm-learning-108 (TODO: register the extension-first authoring policy)
